channel.title: Simple Memo Dev Log
channel.description: Engineering notes from building Simple Memo, an iPhone app for quick capture: architecture, performance, privacy, and iOS APIs such as SpeechAnalyzer.

item.title: iOS 26 didn't kill custom vocabulary — you're adding it to the wrong module
item.dc:creator: AI ATAKA
item.description: iOS 26 contextualStrings is documented for DictationTranscriber. Learn its limits, setContext behavior, and how to choose the right speech module.

item.title: iOS 26 SpeechAnalyzer Live Mic: Setup, Results, and Troubleshooting
item.dc:creator: AI ATAKA
item.description: Connect iOS 26 SpeechAnalyzer to a live mic: check model assets, PCM format, final results, DictationTranscriber vocabulary, and sample validation limits.

item.title: [Dev Log Day 1] Loved Captio So Much, I Had to Recreate That Experience
item.dc:creator: AI ATAKA
item.description: Dissecting the Captio experience and documenting every technical decision: UIKit architecture, Outbox pattern, Relay API, and privacy-first design.

item.title: Outbox Architecture: Zero Message Loss Design
item.dc:creator: AI ATAKA
item.description: UI clears the instant you tap send, yet messages are never lost. The complete Outbox architecture with AES-GCM encryption, exponential backoff retry, and NWPathMonitor connectivity detection.

item.title: Privacy-First Design: Obsessive Attention to Detail in a Memo App
item.dc:creator: AI ATAKA
item.description: Simple Memo’s on-device encryption, session storage, logs and analytics explained, including app-switcher visibility and email delivery limits.

item.title: Relay API Design: Building Email Infrastructure on Cloudflare Workers
item.dc:creator: AI ATAKA
item.description: Breaking free from external email API dependency. Edge computing email infrastructure with Cloudflare Workers + Resend API.

item.title: UIKit vs SwiftUI: Why We Chose UIKit for Launch Speed
item.dc:creator: AI ATAKA
item.description: Deliberately choosing UIKit in 2026. Achieving Time-to-Text under 500ms with no Storyboard, direct VC instantiation, and becomeFirstResponder in viewDidAppear — 200-300ms on real devices.
